reconstructed_theorem_text: E_n=EuclideanSpace R (Fin(n+1)), the real (n+1)-coordinate space with its l2 Euclidean norm. Let S_n={z in E_n: ||z||=1}, considered as a subtype when it is used as a carrier. Let H=homeomorphUnitSphereProd E_n:E_n\{0} -> S_n x (0,infinity), and q=Subtype.val composed with H inverse. Define sigma_n=volume_E_n.toSphere. Its supplied literal body is (n+1) times the first marginal of comap(q,volume_E_n), restricted to S_n x {r in (0,infinity):r<1}. The characterization of H's first component is z -> z/||z||. This states the exact polar-measure construction; no identification with another geometric volume is assumed. The target defines sigma_n by volume.toSphere for every natural n. It is a measure definition only; finiteness, positivity, exact total area, probability normalization, and equality to a separately defined Hausdorff or Riemannian measure are not conclusions of this declaration.
